_comment: Per event: folder, the link-shared Google Drive folder holding the clean match videos (USMIBEQ_<match>_<team>.mp4 and its .json), the only copy a cloud session can download; gallery, the event's video-evidence gallery (a claude.ai artifact); fixlist, the fix list made from the event (a claude.ai artifact). How to add an event: tools/match-review/README.md.
